title: Pool_Exhaustion trigger re-checks eval-time pool size; a marginal pool sheds every tick without ever firing the crisis
evidence:
core/crisis.odin:441-443: "if len(state.flow.packets) >= int(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) &&\n	drop_of_reason_this_tick(state, .Pool_Exhaustion) {"
core/flow.odin:617: "// 1. SPAWN — two coexisting sources (the briefing's \"keep both\" decision):"
core/flow.odin:785: "// 4. SERVE — 3.3 node serialization (ODN-3): per bundle, serve the on-edge"
detail: E22 drops record at admission (flow phase 1); service (phase 4) runs before crisis_evaluate in the same tick. A pool that sheds at admission then drains below cap by eval never triggers, despite continuous Pool_Exhaustion drops — the (b) E9 path trusts drop evidence alone.
recommended_fix: Key the trigger on the drop-site evidence (admission-time at-cap is implied by the E22 drop), or record admission-time pool occupancy in Drop_Site and check that.
